title: tell
description: Sends a private message to one or more players.
note: In 1.21.60, the message text supports input glyph replacement. For example, `:_input_key.jump:` is rendered as `JUMP` on keyboard or as a glyph on a gamepad.

fields.title: target
fields.description: A `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player to tell.
